example_en: The damage was caused by the contractor's negligence.
example_zh: 損害是承包商的過失造成的。

example_en: The liability cap does not apply to fraud.
example_zh: 賠償上限不適用於詐欺行為。

example_en: Missing two payments counts as a default.
example_zh: 兩期未付款即視為違約。
note: 在 IT 語境是「預設值」，合約中是「違約」

example_en: We can terminate if the supplier files for bankruptcy.
example_zh: 若供應商聲請破產，我們可以終止合約。

example_en: We have an audit right once a year.
example_zh: 我們每年有一次稽核權。

example_en: Legal sent a demand letter for the unpaid invoices.
example_zh: 法務針對未付款的帳單寄出了存證信函。

example_en: We sent a cease and desist letter to the copycat site.
example_zh: 我們向仿冒網站寄發了停止侵權通知函。

example_en: Please consult legal counsel before replying.
example_zh: 回覆前請先諮詢法律顧問。

example_en: The losing party pays all legal fees.
example_zh: 敗訴方須負擔所有律師費。

example_en: This clause creates a big legal risk for us.
example_zh: 這項條款對我們造成很大的法律風險。

example_en: Please send us your redline by Wednesday.
example_zh: 請在週三前寄來你們的修訂版。

example_en: I have marked my comments in tracked changes.
example_zh: 我已用追蹤修訂標註我的意見。

example_en: Most of the last section is standard boilerplate.
example_zh: 最後一節大多是制式條款。

example_en: Always read the fine print before you sign.
example_zh: 簽名前一定要看清楚細則。

example_en: Legal found a loophole in the pricing clause.
example_zh: 法務在價格條款中發現了一個漏洞。

example_en: Whereas both parties wish to cooperate, they agree as follows.
example_zh: 鑑於雙方有意合作，茲約定如下。

example_en: ABC Telecom (hereinafter "the Supplier") agrees to the terms.
example_zh: ABC 電信（以下簡稱「供應商」）同意本條款。

example_en: We hereby confirm our acceptance of your offer.
example_zh: 我們特此確認接受貴方報價。

example_en: Notwithstanding Article 5, fees are non-refundable.
example_zh: 不受第五條影響，費用一概不予退還。

example_en: Payment is made pursuant to Section 4.
example_zh: 付款依第四條辦理。

example_en: Data is stored in accordance with company policy.
example_zh: 資料依公司政策保存。

example_en: The price is subject to final approval.
example_zh: 此價格須經最終核准才算確定。

example_en: The buyer shall pay within thirty days.
example_zh: 買方應於三十天內付款。
note: 合約中 shall 表示法律義務，比 will 更正式

example_en: We prefer a mutual NDA instead of a one-way one.
example_zh: 我們比較希望簽雙向保密協議，而不是單向的。

example_en: Both parties will negotiate in good faith.
example_zh: 雙方將本於誠信進行協商。

example_en: The vendor will use reasonable efforts to fix bugs.
example_zh: 廠商將以合理努力修正錯誤。

example_en: Bonuses are paid at the company's sole discretion.
example_zh: 獎金由公司全權決定是否發放。

example_en: Do not disclose the data to any third party.
example_zh: 請勿將資料揭露給任何第三方。

example_en: Our affiliates in Japan may also use the license.
example_zh: 我們在日本的關係企業也可以使用此授權。

example_en: Costs include, but are not limited to, travel and shipping.
example_zh: 費用包括但不限於差旅費與運費。

example_en: For the avoidance of doubt, prices exclude tax.
example_zh: 為避免疑義，價格皆未稅。

example_en: Unless otherwise agreed, delivery is within four weeks.
example_zh: 除非另有約定，否則四週內交貨。

en: to the extent permitted by law
example_en: To the extent permitted by law, we exclude all implied warranties.
example_zh: 在法律允許的範圍內，我們排除所有默示保證。

example_en: The supplier will replace defective parts at its own expense.
example_zh: 供應商將自費更換瑕疵零件。

example_en: We terminate the agreement with immediate effect.
example_zh: 我們終止本協議，立即生效。

example_en: They rejected our price and made a counteroffer.
example_zh: 他們拒絕了我們的價格，另外提出還價。

example_en: A verbal agreement is hard to prove later.
example_zh: 口頭協議事後很難舉證。

example_en: We need to negotiate the liability terms again.
example_zh: 我們需要再協商責任條款。

example_en: The client wants to renegotiate the monthly fee.
example_zh: 客戶想重新協商月費。

example_en: The total contract value is NT$12 million.
example_zh: 合約總金額為新台幣一千兩百萬元。

example_en: The contract period is two years from signing.
example_zh: 合約期間為簽約起兩年。

example_en: We use a system for contract management and renewals.
example_zh: 我們用一套系統做合約管理與續約提醒。

example_en: Our offer remains valid until the end of this month.
example_zh: 我們的報價在本月底前有效。

example_en: The contract is formed upon written acceptance of the offer.
example_zh: 要約經書面承諾後，合約即成立。

example_en: The monthly fee is the consideration for the services.
example_zh: 月費就是這些服務的對價。
note: 一般用語是「考慮」，合約中指交換的代價

example_en: Please countersign the agreement and return one copy to us.
example_zh: 請會簽本協議後寄回一份給我們。

example_en: The regulator may revoke the license for serious violations.
example_zh: 若有重大違規，主管機關可撤銷執照。

example_en: The buyer may rescind the contract if the goods are fake.
example_zh: 若貨品為假貨，買方可以解除合約。

example_en: Any assignment without consent shall be null and void.
example_zh: 未經同意的任何讓與均屬無效。

example_en: A contract signed under pressure may be voidable.
example_zh: 在脅迫下簽訂的合約可能得被撤銷。

zh: 行為能力；法律上的資格
example_en: Minors may lack the legal capacity to sign a contract.
example_zh: 未成年人可能不具簽約的行為能力。

example_en: Mobile service plans usually use a standard form contract.
example_zh: 行動電話方案通常採用定型化契約。

example_en: The recitals explain why the parties are entering into this agreement.
example_zh: 前言條款說明雙方簽訂本協議的緣由。

example_en: Check the definitions clause before reading the rest.
example_zh: 閱讀其他內容前，先看定義條款。

example_en: The price list is attached as Annex B.
example_zh: 價目表列於附件 B。

example_en: This agreement may be signed in counterparts.
example_zh: 本協議得由各方分別簽署多份。

example_en: Each contracting party must keep a signed copy.
example_zh: 各締約方都須保存一份簽署本。

example_en: The parties hereto agree to the following terms.
example_zh: 本合約雙方同意下列條款。

example_en: Unless defined herein, terms have their ordinary meaning.
example_zh: 除本合約另有定義外，用語依一般意義解釋。

example_en: The software and any copies thereof remain our property.
example_zh: 該軟體及其任何複本仍屬我方所有。

zh: 依本合約；在本合約項下
example_en: All fees payable hereunder exclude sales tax.
example_zh: 依本合約應付的所有費用均未含營業稅。

zh: 準用（細節依情況調整後適用）
example_en: Clause 8 applies mutatis mutandis to subcontractors.
example_zh: 第 8 條準用於分包商。
note: 拉丁文

example_en: We will consider any bona fide offer from qualified buyers.
example_zh: 合格買家的任何誠意報價我們都會考慮。
note: 拉丁文

example_en: The initial term is two years from the effective date.
example_zh: 初始期間為自生效日起兩年。

example_en: Billing starts on the service commencement date.
example_zh: 計費自服務起始日開始。

example_en: The term of this lease is three years.
example_zh: 本租約期間為三年。
note: 單數常指「合約期間」，複數 terms 指「條件／條款」

example_en: Our maintenance contract expires next March.
example_zh: 我們的維護合約明年三月到期。

example_en: Can we discuss the payment terms before signing?
example_zh: 簽約前可以先談付款條件嗎？

zh: 發票日起 30 天內付款（月結 30 天）
example_en: Invoices are payable net 30 from the invoice date.
example_zh: 發票須於開立日起 30 天內付款。

example_en: A 30% advance payment is required upon signing.
example_zh: 簽約時須支付 30% 預付款。

example_en: We paid a down payment to reserve the equipment.
example_zh: 我們付了訂金來保留這批設備。

example_en: The fee will be paid in three equal installments.
example_zh: 費用將分三期平均支付。

zh: 里程碑付款（依階段完成付款）
example_en: The second milestone payment is due after system testing.
example_zh: 第二筆里程碑付款在系統測試後支付。

example_en: Ten percent retention money is released after the warranty ends.
example_zh: 一成保留款於保固期結束後撥付。

example_en: Any price adjustment requires 60 days' notice.
example_zh: 任何價格調整都須提前 60 天通知。

example_en: The price escalation clause links fees to inflation.
example_zh: 物價調整條款讓費用隨通膨連動。

example_en: The most favored customer clause guarantees us the lowest price.
example_zh: 最惠客戶條款保證我們拿到最低價。

example_en: Neither party may exercise set-off without written agreement.
example_zh: 未經書面同意，任一方不得主張抵銷。

example_en: Royalties paid overseas are subject to withholding tax.
example_zh: 支付給海外的權利金須扣繳稅款。

example_en: The supplier must provide a bank guarantee before delivery.
example_zh: 供應商須在交貨前提供銀行保證函。

example_en: Payment will be made by an irrevocable letter of credit.
example_zh: 將以不可撤銷信用狀付款。

example_en: The bank asked for the building as collateral.
example_zh: 銀行要求以這棟大樓作為擔保品。

example_en: The contractor placed a lien on the equipment for unpaid fees.
example_zh: 承包商因款項未付而對設備主張留置權。

example_en: The parent company will act as guarantor for this loan.
example_zh: 母公司將擔任這筆借款的保證人。

example_en: Consortium members bear joint and several liability to the client.
example_zh: 聯盟成員對客戶負連帶責任。

example_en: The liability cap equals the fees paid in the last 12 months.
example_zh: 賠償上限為過去 12 個月已付的費用。

example_en: The vendor shall hold us harmless from any third-party claims.
example_zh: 廠商應使我方免受任何第三方求償的損害。

example_en: We will reimburse reasonable travel expenses with receipts.
example_zh: 合理差旅費憑收據核銷。

example_en: The customer is seeking compensation for the service outage.
example_zh: 客戶要求就服務中斷給予賠償。

example_en: Each deliverable is listed in the statement of work.
example_zh: 每項交付成果都列在工作說明書中。

example_en: The acceptance test will be held on site next week.
example_zh: 驗收測試下週在現場進行。

example_en: Let's agree on clear acceptance criteria before development starts.
example_zh: 開發開始前，我們先訂好明確的驗收標準。

example_en: Final payment is due after the acceptance certificate is signed.
example_zh: 驗收單簽署後即支付尾款。

example_en: Transfer of title occurs upon full payment.
example_zh: 全額付清後所有權才移轉。

example_en: Risk of loss passes to the buyer at delivery.
example_zh: 交貨時滅失風險即移轉給買方。

zh: 國貿條規（國際貿易條件）
example_en: Which Incoterms apply to this shipment from Japan?
example_zh: 這批從日本出貨的貨物適用哪一種國貿條規？

example_en: The price is quoted FOB Yokohama.
example_zh: 報價條件為橫濱港船上交貨。

example_en: The vendor failed to perform its obligations on time.
example_zh: 廠商未能如期履行義務。

example_en: We have fulfilled all conditions under the agreement.
example_zh: 我們已達成協議中的所有條件。

zh: 時間為契約要素（逾期即構成重大違約）
example_en: Time is of the essence for the network launch date.
example_zh: 網路開通日期為本合約的關鍵要素。

example_en: We may suspend performance if invoices remain unpaid.
example_zh: 若帳款未付，我方得暫停履行。

example_en: The SLA guarantees 99.9% network availability.
example_zh: 服務水準協議保證 99.9% 的網路可用率。

zh: 服務抵減金（未達 SLA 的補償）
example_en: Missing the SLA triggers a 5% service credit.
example_zh: 未達服務水準時，將給予 5% 服務抵減金。

example_en: The routers come with a two-year warranty.
example_zh: 這批路由器附兩年保固。

example_en: Repairs within the warranty period are free of charge.
example_zh: 保固期內維修免費。

example_en: All implied warranties are excluded to the extent permitted.
example_zh: 在法律允許範圍內，排除一切默示擔保。

example_en: We make no warranty of fitness for a particular purpose.
example_zh: 我方不擔保產品符合特定用途。

example_en: The license excludes any warranty of merchantability.
example_zh: 本授權排除任何適售性擔保。

example_en: The used equipment is sold as is.
example_zh: 這批二手設備依現狀出售。

example_en: The provider disclaims liability for third-party content.
example_zh: 業者聲明對第三方內容不負責任。

example_en: The seller remains liable for any latent defect.
example_zh: 賣方仍須對隱藏瑕疵負責。

example_en: The court may order specific performance instead of damages.
example_zh: 法院可判決強制實際履行，而非金錢賠償。

example_en: Non-performance caused by force majeure is excused.
example_zh: 因不可抗力導致的不履行得免責。

example_en: Late delivery would be a breach of contract.
example_zh: 延遲交貨將構成違約。

example_en: Insolvency of the borrower is an event of default.
example_zh: 借款人無力清償即構成違約事件。

example_en: Termination is not our only remedy for the breach.
example_zh: 終止合約並非我方對該違約的唯一救濟。

example_en: Service credits are the customer's sole remedy for downtime.
example_zh: 服務抵減金是客戶就停機的唯一救濟。

example_en: Punitive damages are excluded under this agreement.
example_zh: 本協議排除懲罰性賠償。

example_en: Neither party is liable for loss of profits.
example_zh: 雙方均不對利潤損失負責。

example_en: Each party must take steps to mitigate its losses.
example_zh: 各方都應採取措施減輕損失。

example_en: Only foreseeable losses can be claimed.
example_zh: 只有可預見的損失才能求償。

zh: 天災（人力無法抗拒的自然事件）
example_en: The typhoon was treated as an act of God.
example_zh: 這次颱風被視為天災。

example_en: The contractor must make good any damage to the building.
example_zh: 承包商須修復對大樓造成的任何損壞。

example_en: We may terminate for cause if the breach is not cured.
example_zh: 違約未補正時，我方得因可歸責事由終止合約。

zh: 存續條款（合約終止後仍有效的條款）
example_en: Confidentiality is covered by the survival clause.
example_zh: 保密義務屬於存續條款的範圍。

zh: 過渡服務（移轉期間的支援）
example_en: The vendor will provide transition services for six months.
example_zh: 廠商將提供六個月的過渡服務。

example_en: A change of control allows the other party to terminate.
example_zh: 發生控制權變更時，對方得終止合約。

example_en: The assignee takes over all rights under the contract.
example_zh: 受讓人承接合約下的所有權利。

zh: 契約更替（由新當事人取代原當事人）
example_en: After the merger, all supplier contracts require novation.
example_zh: 合併後，所有供應商合約都需辦理契約更替。

example_en: This agreement binds the parties and their successors and assigns.
example_zh: 本協議對雙方及其繼受人與受讓人均具拘束力。

example_en: No variation is valid unless signed by both parties.
example_zh: 任何變更須經雙方簽署才生效。

example_en: Please review the software license agreement before installing.
example_zh: 安裝前請先詳閱軟體授權合約。

example_en: The licensor grants you a non-exclusive right to use the software.
example_zh: 授權人授予您使用該軟體的非專屬權利。

example_en: A perpetual license costs more upfront than a subscription.
example_zh: 永久授權的初期成本比訂閱制高。

example_en: We grant the client a royalty-free license to the design.
example_zh: 我們授予客戶該設計的免權利金授權。

example_en: The territory covers Taiwan and Hong Kong only.
example_zh: 授權區域僅限台灣與香港。

zh: 使用領域（授權用途範圍）
example_en: The patent license is limited to the telecom field of use.
example_zh: 該專利授權的使用領域限於電信業。

zh: 委託著作（成果權利歸委託方）
example_en: All code written for us is a work for hire.
example_zh: 為我方撰寫的所有程式碼均屬委託著作。

example_en: Ownership of the deliverables passes to the client on payment.
example_zh: 付款後，交付成果的所有權歸客戶。

zh: 既有智慧財產（合作前已擁有的智財）
example_en: Each party retains ownership of its background IP.
example_zh: 各方保有其既有智慧財產的所有權。

example_en: Source code escrow protects us if the vendor goes bankrupt.
example_zh: 若廠商破產，原始碼託管可以保障我方。

example_en: The licensee shall not reverse engineer the firmware.
example_zh: 被授權人不得對韌體進行逆向工程。

example_en: The designer agrees not to exercise moral rights against us.
example_zh: 設計師同意不對我方行使著作人格權。

example_en: Customs seized a shipment of counterfeit chargers.
example_zh: 海關查扣了一批仿冒充電器。

example_en: Quoting a short passage for training may count as fair use.
example_zh: 為教育訓練引用短篇段落可能屬於合理使用。

example_en: The product does not infringe any third-party patent.
example_zh: 本產品未侵害任何第三方專利。

example_en: Do not disclose pricing details to other vendors.
example_zh: 請勿向其他廠商透露價格細節。

example_en: The disclosing party must mark documents as confidential.
example_zh: 揭露方須在文件上標示機密。

example_en: The receiving party shall protect the information with reasonable care.
example_zh: 接收方應以合理注意保護該資訊。

example_en: Share the draft on a need-to-know basis only.
example_zh: 草稿僅提供給有必要知悉的人。

example_en: As data controller, we decide how customer data is used.
example_zh: 身為資料控制者，我們決定客戶資料的用途。

zh: 資料處理者（受託處理資料的一方）
example_en: The call center vendor acts as our data processor.
example_zh: 客服中心廠商是我們的資料處理者。

example_en: A data subject may request deletion of their records.
example_zh: 資料當事人可要求刪除其個人紀錄。

zh: 歐盟一般資料保護規則
example_en: Our roaming data for EU users must comply with GDPR.
example_zh: 歐盟用戶的漫遊資料必須符合 GDPR。
note: General Data Protection Regulation

example_en: We need the customer's consent before sharing their data.
example_zh: 分享客戶資料前需取得其同意。

example_en: Breach notification must be sent within 72 hours.
example_zh: 外洩通報須在 72 小時內發出。

example_en: The retention period for call records is six months.
example_zh: 通話紀錄的保存期限為六個月。

example_en: On termination, return or destroy all confidential materials.
example_zh: 合約終止時，應返還或銷毀所有機密資料。

example_en: The plaintiff claims the network outage caused heavy losses.
example_zh: 原告主張網路中斷造成重大損失。

example_en: Our company was named as a defendant in the case.
example_zh: 本公司在此案中被列為被告。

example_en: The court issued a judgment in our favor.
example_zh: 法院作出對我方有利的判決。

example_en: Legal plans to appeal the decision.
example_zh: 法務打算對該判決提起上訴。

example_en: The first hearing is scheduled for next Tuesday.
example_zh: 第一次開庭排在下週二。

example_en: The engineer's testimony explained the cause of the outage.
example_zh: 工程師的證詞說明了斷線的原因。

example_en: The burden of proof lies with the claimant.
example_zh: 舉證責任在求償方。

example_en: This discount should not set a precedent for future deals.
example_zh: 這次折扣不應成為日後交易的先例。

example_en: We will take legal action if payment is not received.
example_zh: 若仍未收到款項，我們將採取法律行動。

example_en: Users filed a class action over the data leak.
example_zh: 用戶就資料外洩提起集體訴訟。

example_en: The supplier filed a counterclaim for unpaid invoices.
example_zh: 供應商就未付帳款提起反訴。

example_en: The arbitral award is final and binding on both parties.
example_zh: 仲裁判斷為終局，對雙方均有拘束力。

example_en: The Taipei District Court has exclusive jurisdiction.
example_zh: 以臺灣臺北地方法院為專屬管轄法院。

example_en: Follow the escalation procedure before starting arbitration.
example_zh: 提付仲裁前，須先走爭議升級處理程序。

example_en: The parties shall first try to resolve disputes amicably.
example_zh: 雙方應先嘗試以友好方式解決爭議。

example_en: Our attorney will review the final draft.
example_zh: 我們的律師會審閱最終版草約。

example_en: We hired an outside law firm for the merger.
example_zh: 我們為這次合併委任了外部律師事務所。

zh: 企業內部法務；公司法務長
example_en: Please check with our in-house counsel first.
example_zh: 請先跟我們公司法務確認。

zh: 預付委任費；常年顧問費
example_en: We pay the law firm a monthly retainer.
example_zh: 我們每月支付律師事務所常年顧問費。

zh: 訴訟資料保全（禁止刪除相關資料）
example_en: All emails about the project are under legal hold.
example_zh: 該專案相關的所有郵件都在訴訟保全範圍內，不得刪除。

example_en: Our Taiwan subsidiary will sign the local contract.
example_zh: 由我們的台灣子公司簽署當地合約。

example_en: The parent company in Tokyo must approve this deal.
example_zh: 這筆交易須經東京母公司核准。

example_en: A board resolution is needed to sign contracts above this amount.
example_zh: 超過此金額的合約須經董事會決議。

example_en: The bank requested a copy of our articles of incorporation.
example_zh: 銀行要求提供我們的公司章程影本。

example_en: Stamp duty applies to certain contracts in Taiwan.
example_zh: 在台灣，部分合約須繳納印花稅。

example_en: The power of attorney must be signed before a notary public.
example_zh: 授權書必須在公證人面前簽署。

example_en: The merger needs antitrust clearance in several countries.
example_zh: 這起合併需取得多國的反壟斷審查許可。

zh: 聯合壟斷組織；聯合行為
example_en: Sharing price plans with competitors may look like a cartel.
example_zh: 與競爭對手分享資費方案可能被視為聯合行為。

example_en: Bid rigging is a serious violation of competition law.
example_zh: 圍標嚴重違反公平競爭法規。

example_en: We plan to join the government tender for 5G base stations.
example_zh: 我們打算參加政府的 5G 基地台標案。

example_en: A bid bond must be submitted with the proposal.
example_zh: 投標時須一併繳交押標金。

example_en: Accepting a kickback from a vendor leads to dismissal.
example_zh: 收受廠商回扣將遭解僱。

zh: 疏通費（為加速行政程序而給的小額款項）
example_en: Our policy bans facilitation payments to customs officials.
example_zh: 公司政策禁止向海關人員支付疏通費。

example_en: The auditor discovered signs of embezzlement.
example_zh: 稽核人員發現了侵占公款的跡象。

example_en: Trading shares before the announcement may be insider trading.
example_zh: 在公告前買賣股票可能構成內線交易。

example_en: This requirement comes from a statute, not company policy.
example_zh: 這項要求來自法規，而非公司政策。

example_en: New legislation will tighten rules on SIM card registration.
example_zh: 新法規將加嚴 SIM 卡登記規定。

example_en: The spectrum license is valid for 15 years.
example_zh: 該頻譜執照效期為 15 年。

example_en: The bank requires a legal opinion before releasing the loan.
example_zh: 銀行要求先提出法律意見書才會撥款。

example_en: The consulting agreement covers 40 hours of advice per month.
example_zh: 這份顧問合約每月包含 40 小時的諮詢。

example_en: We cannot sublease the office without the landlord's consent.
example_zh: 未經房東同意，我們不能轉租辦公室。

example_en: The interconnection agreement sets the call termination rates.
example_zh: 網路互連協議訂定了通話接續費率。

example_en: Under the reseller agreement, they sell our plans under their brand.
example_zh: 依轉售合約，對方以自有品牌販售我們的方案。

example_en: The agency agreement pays a 5% commission on each sale.
example_zh: 代理合約規定每筆銷售給付 5% 佣金。

example_en: Many of our retail stores are run as franchises.
example_zh: 我們很多門市是以加盟方式經營。

example_en: The OEM agreement lets the factory build routers under our brand.
example_zh: 依代工合約，工廠以我們的品牌生產路由器。

example_en: The supply agreement guarantees 10,000 units per quarter.
example_zh: 供貨合約保證每季供應一萬台。

example_en: Individual orders are placed under the framework agreement.
example_zh: 個別訂單依框架協議下單。

example_en: The maintenance agreement includes 24/7 on-site support.
example_zh: 維護合約包含全天候到場支援。

example_en: We need the landlord's approval to install antennas on the roof.
example_zh: 在屋頂架設天線需要房東同意。

example_en: The tenant is responsible for minor repairs.
example_zh: 小型修繕由承租人負責。

example_en: She was hired on a one-year fixed-term contract.
example_zh: 她以一年期的定期契約受聘。

example_en: Overtime pay must follow the Labor Standards Act.
example_zh: 加班費必須依照《勞動基準法》計算。

example_en: All employees must follow the company's work rules.
example_zh: 全體員工都須遵守公司工作規則。

example_en: The labor dispute was settled through mediation.
example_zh: 這起勞資爭議經調解解決。

example_en: The former employee sued for unfair dismissal.
example_zh: 前員工以不當解僱提告。

example_en: Report any sexual harassment to HR immediately.
example_zh: 任何性騷擾事件請立即通報人資。

example_en: Tower climbers need occupational safety training every year.
example_zh: 鐵塔施工人員每年都須接受職業安全訓練。

zh: 乾淨版（無修訂標記的版本）
example_en: Please send a clean copy along with the redline.
example_zh: 請連同修訂版一起寄一份乾淨版。

zh: 簽署版（定稿供簽署的版本）
example_en: This is the execution version, so no further edits please.
example_zh: 這是簽署版，請勿再修改。

example_en: Legal wants to change the wording of Clause 5.
example_zh: 法務想修改第 5 條的措辭。

example_en: Please remove any ambiguity about the delivery date.
example_zh: 請消除交貨日期上的任何模糊之處。

example_en: Nothing here shall be construed as a partnership.
example_zh: 本合約任何內容均不得解釋為合夥關係。

example_en: The order of precedence places the main contract above the annexes.
example_zh: 依優先適用順序，主約優先於各附件。

example_en: Notices are deemed received two days after sending.
example_zh: 通知於寄出兩日後視為送達。

example_en: The contract stipulates delivery within 30 days.
example_zh: 合約明定須於 30 天內交貨。

example_en: The loan includes a covenant to keep debt below a set level.
example_zh: 該貸款含有將負債維持在一定水準以下的約定事項。

example_en: Regulatory approval is a condition precedent to closing.
example_zh: 取得主管機關核准是交割的先決條件。

example_en: The bonus is contingent on reaching the sales target.
example_zh: 獎金視是否達成業績目標而定。

example_en: A material adverse change allows the buyer to walk away.
example_zh: 發生重大不利變更時，買方可退出交易。

example_en: The vendor will use commercially reasonable efforts to fix bugs.
example_zh: 廠商將盡商業上合理的努力修正錯誤。

example_en: Best efforts is a stricter duty than reasonable efforts.
example_zh: 「盡最大努力」比「合理努力」的義務更嚴格。

example_en: Compliance training is mandatory for all sales staff.
example_zh: 所有業務人員都必須參加法遵訓練。

example_en: Interest accrues daily on overdue amounts.
example_zh: 逾期款項的利息按日累計。

example_en: The customer is entitled to a full refund within seven days.
example_zh: 客戶有權在七天內全額退費。

example_en: You may use the logo, provided that you follow our guidelines.
example_zh: 您可以使用此商標，前提是遵守我們的規範。

example_en: Please confirm the price change in writing.
example_zh: 請以書面確認價格變更。

example_en: Signed by the duly authorized representatives of both parties.
example_zh: 由雙方經正式授權的代表簽署。

example_en: The undersigned confirms that the information is accurate.
example_zh: 簽署人確認上述資訊正確無誤。

zh: 為昭信守（合約結尾套語）
example_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have signed this agreement.
example_zh: 為昭信守，雙方簽署本協議。

example_en: Add the CEO's title to the signature block.
example_zh: 請在簽名欄加上執行長的職稱。

zh: 準據語言（以哪個語言版本為準）
example_en: English is the governing language if the translations differ.
example_zh: 若譯本有出入，以英文版本為準。

example_en: As their largest customer, we have strong bargaining power.
example_zh: 身為對方最大客戶，我們的議價能力很強。

example_en: Let's agree on the key terms before drafting the contract.
example_zh: 擬約前，我們先談妥主要條款。

example_en: Please send me the agenda before Monday's meeting.
example_zh: 請在週一會議前把議程寄給我。

example_en: The network upgrade is the first agenda item today.
example_zh: 網路升級是今天第一個議程項目。

example_en: Can we schedule a meeting with the Tokyo team?
example_zh: 我們可以跟東京團隊安排一場會議嗎？

example_en: I have back-to-back meetings until 4 p.m.
example_zh: 我到下午四點都是一場接一場的會議。

example_en: The client asked to postpone the meeting by one week.
example_zh: 客戶要求把會議延後一週。

example_en: They called off the meeting because of the typhoon.
example_zh: 因為颱風，他們取消了會議。

example_en: Can we move the meeting up to 10 a.m.?
example_zh: 我們可以把會議提前到早上十點嗎？

example_en: The steering committee meets once a month.
example_zh: 指導委員會每個月開會一次。

example_en: Please share your availability for next week.
example_zh: 請告訴我你下週哪些時間有空。

example_en: Attendance at the training session is mandatory.
example_zh: 這場訓練課程必須出席。

example_en: Mr. Wang sends his regrets; he's traveling today.
example_zh: 王先生致歉無法出席，他今天出差。

example_en: Our weekly sales sync is a recurring meeting.
example_zh: 我們每週的業務同步會是例行會議。

example_en: The kickoff meeting for the 5G project is on Monday.
example_zh: 5G 專案的啟動會議在週一。

zh: 站立會議（每日簡短進度會議）
example_en: Our stand-up meeting starts at 9:15 every day.
example_zh: 我們的站立會議每天九點十五分開始。

example_en: I have a one-on-one with my manager today.
example_zh: 我今天和主管有一對一面談。

example_en: The CEO will speak at the all-hands meeting.
example_zh: 執行長會在全員大會上致詞。

zh: 外部會議（在公司以外地點舉行）
example_en: The strategy off-site meeting will be held in Hsinchu.
example_zh: 策略會議將在新竹的公司外場地舉行。

example_en: The hotel is a good venue for the partner meeting.
example_zh: 這家飯店很適合當合作夥伴會議的場地。

example_en: The conference room on the 8th floor is booked.
example_zh: 八樓的會議室已經被預訂了。

example_en: I'll book a room for twelve people.
example_zh: 我會預訂一間可容納十二人的會議室。

example_en: Each attendee will receive the slides afterward.
example_zh: 每位與會者會後都會收到簡報。

example_en: Two invitees declined the meeting request.
example_zh: 有兩位受邀者婉拒了會議邀請。

example_en: Please RSVP by Wednesday so we can order lunch.
example_zh: 請在週三前回覆是否出席，方便我們訂午餐。
note: 源自法文 répondez s'il vous plaît

example_en: We can't vote because we don't have a quorum.
example_zh: 因為未達法定人數，我們無法表決。

example_en: The keynote speech opens the plenary session.
example_zh: 全體會議由主題演講揭開序幕。

example_en: Sorry I'm late, the previous meeting ran over.
example_zh: 抱歉我遲到了，上一場會議超時了。

example_en: We're running short on time, so let's be brief.
example_zh: 我們時間不太夠了，大家簡短一點。

example_en: What's the head count for tomorrow's training?
example_zh: 明天訓練課程的出席人數是多少？
note: 指出席人數，跟人事 headcount（編制人數）不同。

example_en: The chairperson opened the meeting at nine sharp.
example_zh: 主席在九點整宣布會議開始。

example_en: Ms. Lin will chair today's budget meeting.
example_zh: 林小姐將主持今天的預算會議。

example_en: The facilitator kept the discussion focused.
example_zh: 引導人讓討論保持聚焦。

example_en: The moderator introduced each panelist.
example_zh: 主持人逐一介紹每位與談人。

example_en: Our CTO is a panelist at the 5G forum.
example_zh: 我們的技術長是 5G 論壇的與談人。

example_en: Who will be the minute-taker today?
example_zh: 今天誰負責做會議記錄？

example_en: Kevin, could you be the timekeeper today?
example_zh: Kevin，今天可以請你擔任計時人員嗎？

example_en: The chair called the meeting to order at 2 p.m.
example_zh: 主席在下午兩點宣布會議開始。

example_en: It's ten o'clock, so let's get started.
example_zh: 十點了，我們開始吧。

zh: 會務事項（場地、時間等事務說明）
example_en: Before we begin, a few housekeeping items.
example_zh: 開始之前，先說明幾項會務事項。

example_en: We started the workshop with a short icebreaker.
example_zh: 我們以一個簡短的破冰活動開始工作坊。

example_en: Is there any other business before we close?
example_zh: 結束之前還有臨時動議嗎？
note: 常縮寫為 AOB

example_en: Let's move on to the next item.
example_zh: 我們進入下一個項目。

zh: 不偏離主題；按進度進行
example_en: Let's stay on track; we have six items left.
example_zh: 我們別偏離主題，還有六個項目。

example_en: Sorry, that's a bit off-topic.
example_zh: 抱歉，這有點離題了。

example_en: Forgive me, I digress. Back to the roadmap.
example_zh: 抱歉我離題了，回到產品路線圖。

zh: 待議清單（暫時擱置的議題）
example_en: Let's put that idea in the parking lot for now.
example_zh: 我們先把那個想法列入待議清單。

example_en: We'll table this issue until next month.
example_zh: 我們把這個議題擱置到下個月。
note: 美式指「擱置」，英式指「提出討論」，意思相反

example_en: Here's a quick recap of what we agreed.
example_zh: 簡短回顧一下我們達成共識的事項。

example_en: To sum up, we'll launch the plan in Q3.
example_zh: 總結來說，我們將在第三季推出方案。

example_en: Let's wrap up and send the minutes today.
example_zh: 我們收尾吧，今天把會議記錄寄出。

example_en: The meeting was adjourned at 5 p.m.
example_zh: 會議於下午五點散會。

example_en: We'll set up a follow-up meeting next Tuesday.
example_zh: 我們下週二安排一場後續會議。

example_en: Let's do a quick round-robin for updates.
example_zh: 我們快速輪流報告進度吧。

example_en: Mr. Sato has the floor; please let him finish.
example_zh: 佐藤先生正在發言，請讓他說完。

example_en: Now I'll hand over to Amy for the sales update.
example_zh: 接下來交給 Amy 報告業務進度。

example_en: Please don't interrupt while others are speaking.
example_zh: 別人發言時請不要打斷。

example_en: Sorry to interrupt, but the client is on the line.
example_zh: 抱歉打斷一下，客戶在線上了。

example_en: May I add something about the coverage map?
example_zh: 我可以補充一點關於訊號涵蓋圖的事嗎？

example_en: You have a question? Go ahead.
example_zh: 你有問題嗎？請說。

zh: 先保留這個想法（稍後再談）
example_en: Hold that thought; we'll discuss it after the break.
example_zh: 先保留這個想法，休息後再討論。

example_en: That's a perfect segue into our next topic.
example_zh: 這剛好可以自然帶到我們的下一個主題。

example_en: This is quite detailed, so let's take it offline.
example_zh: 這部分比較細，我們會後再私下討論吧。

example_en: We'll do a quick roll call before we start.
example_zh: 開始前我們快速點個名。

example_en: In my view, the price increase is too risky.
example_zh: 依我看，漲價的風險太高。

example_en: From my perspective, the rollout went smoothly.
example_zh: 從我的角度來看，這次上線很順利。

example_en: I'd like to point out that costs rose 10%.
example_zh: 我想指出成本上升了 10%。

example_en: I concur with Tanaka-san's assessment.
example_zh: 我同意田中先生的評估。

example_en: I couldn't agree more; speed is our priority.
example_zh: 我完全同意，速度是我們的優先考量。

example_en: I take your point, but consider the timeline too.
example_zh: 我接受你的看法，但也要考慮時程。

example_en: I see your point, but the budget is limited.
example_zh: 我明白你的意思，但預算有限。

example_en: I'm afraid I disagree with that estimate.
example_zh: 恐怕我無法同意那個估算。

example_en: I have some reservations about the new vendor.
example_zh: 我對這家新供應商有些疑慮。
note: 此義常用複數：have reservations

example_en: There was little dissent about the new pricing.
example_zh: 大家對新定價幾乎沒有不同意見。

example_en: Let me offer a counterargument.
example_zh: 讓我提出一個反方論點。

example_en: Let me play devil's advocate for a moment.
example_zh: 讓我暫時唱個反調。

example_en: We reached a consensus on the launch date.
example_zh: 我們對上市日期達成了共識。

example_en: The decision to expand coverage was unanimous.
example_zh: 擴大涵蓋範圍的決定獲得全體一致同意。

example_en: We need a compromise both teams can accept.
example_zh: 我們需要一個兩個團隊都能接受的折衷方案。

example_en: Let's focus on the common ground first.
example_zh: 我們先聚焦在彼此的共同點。

example_en: What's headquarters' stance on remote work?
example_zh: 總公司對遠端工作的立場是什麼？

example_en: Just my two cents, but I'd delay the launch.
example_zh: 只是我個人的淺見，我會延後上市。

example_en: Thank you all for the constructive discussion.
example_zh: 謝謝大家有建設性的討論。

example_en: Could you clarify the scope of phase two?
example_zh: 你可以釐清一下第二階段的範圍嗎？

example_en: Could you elaborate on the risks?
example_zh: 可以詳細說明一下風險嗎？

example_en: Let me rephrase the question.
example_zh: 讓我換個方式問。

example_en: Could you expand on the churn data?
example_zh: 你可以進一步說明用戶流失的數據嗎？

example_en: Just to be clear, the deadline is Friday?
example_zh: 確認一下，截止日是週五嗎？

example_en: If I understand correctly, you need two more engineers.
example_zh: 如果我理解沒錯，你們還需要兩位工程師。

example_en: What do you mean by 'soft launch'?
example_zh: 你說的「試營運」是指什麼？

example_en: Sales and engineering don't always see eye to eye.
example_zh: 業務和工程部門的看法不一定一致。

en: Let me get back to you on that.
ipa: /lɛt miː ɡɛt bæk tə juː ɑːn ðæt/
example_en: Good question. Let me get back to you on that.
example_zh: 好問題，這點我再回覆您。

example_en: Would anyone from finance like to weigh in?
example_zh: 財務部有人想發表意見嗎？

example_en: Feel free to chime in at any time.
example_zh: 隨時歡迎加入討論。

example_en: If you have concerns, please speak up.
example_zh: 如果有疑慮，請說出來。

example_en: Several engineers voiced a concern about the deadline.
example_zh: 幾位工程師對截止日期表達了疑慮。

en: That's not quite what I meant.
example_en: Sorry, that's not quite what I meant.
example_zh: 抱歉，我不完全是這個意思。

example_en: Let's brainstorm names for the new data plan.
example_zh: 我們來腦力激盪新資費方案的名稱。

example_en: I'll draw the network diagram on the whiteboard.
example_zh: 我會在白板上畫網路架構圖。

example_en: Write one idea per sticky note.
example_zh: 每張便利貼寫一個點子。

example_en: We made a mind map of customer pain points.
example_zh: 我們做了一張客戶痛點的心智圖。

example_en: We need to think outside the box to reduce churn.
example_zh: 要降低用戶流失，我們得跳脫框架思考。

zh: 找人交換想法、聽取意見
example_en: Can I bounce some ideas off you?
example_zh: 我可以跟你交換一些想法嗎？

example_en: I'd like to build on what Mei said.
example_zh: 我想延伸美玲剛才說的內容。

en: no idea is a bad idea
example_en: Remember, in brainstorming no idea is a bad idea.
example_zh: 記住，腦力激盪時沒有不好的點子。

example_en: Your survey results gave us food for thought.
example_zh: 你的調查結果很值得我們深思。

example_en: I'd like to make a motion to approve the budget.
example_zh: 我提議通過這份預算。

example_en: Does anyone second the motion?
example_zh: 有人附議這項動議嗎？

example_en: She put forward a plan to cut costs.
example_zh: 她提出了一個降低成本的方案。

example_en: We'll vote on the proposal at the end.
example_zh: 我們最後再就這項提案表決。

example_en: Let's decide by a show of hands.
example_zh: 我們舉手表決吧。

example_en: Two members abstained from the vote.
example_zh: 有兩位成員投票棄權。

example_en: The majority supported the new design.
example_zh: 多數人支持新設計。

example_en: The director vetoed the proposal.
example_zh: 處長否決了這項提案。

example_en: The board won't just rubber-stamp this budget.
example_zh: 董事會不會隨便就批准這份預算。

example_en: Management gave us the green light.
example_zh: 管理層已經給我們開綠燈。

example_en: Let's list the pros and cons of each option.
example_zh: 我們列出每個選項的優缺點。

example_en: There's a trade-off between speed and cost.
example_zh: 速度與成本之間需要取捨。

example_en: We shortlisted three vendors for the final round.
example_zh: 我們把三家供應商列入最後一輪候選。

example_en: We need to reach a decision by noon.
example_zh: 我們需要在中午前做出決定。

example_en: Let's defer the decision until we see the data.
example_zh: 等看到數據再做決定吧。

example_en: The general manager has the final say.
example_zh: 總經理擁有最終決定權。

example_en: The discussion ended in a deadlock.
example_zh: 討論最後陷入僵局。

example_en: The board overruled the committee's decision.
example_zh: 董事會推翻了委員會的決定。

example_en: I'll circulate the minutes by tomorrow.
example_zh: 我明天前會傳閱會議記錄。
note: 此義恆用複數

example_en: Let's start with matters arising from last week.
example_zh: 我們先從上週會議的延續事項開始。

example_en: The key takeaway is that customers want simpler plans.
example_zh: 主要的重點是客戶想要更簡單的資費方案。

example_en: Let's agree on next steps before we leave.
example_zh: 離開前我們先確認後續步驟。

example_en: First, can we approve the minutes of the last meeting?
example_zh: 首先，可以確認上次的會議記錄嗎？

example_en: The AI tool creates a transcript of each call.
example_zh: 這個 AI 工具會為每通會議產生逐字稿。

example_en: Please take a handout as you come in.
example_zh: 進場時請拿一份講義。

example_en: Please review the pre-read before Thursday.
example_zh: 週四前請先看完會前閱讀資料。

example_en: For the record, I opposed this plan.
example_zh: 我在此鄭重說明，我反對這個計畫。

example_en: We'll hold a debrief after the trade show.
example_zh: 展覽結束後我們會開檢討會。

example_en: There's a short briefing before the client visit.
example_zh: 客戶來訪前有一場簡短的說明會。

example_en: We hold a video conference with Osaka every week.
example_zh: 我們每週和大阪開視訊會議。

example_en: Please join the conference call five minutes early.
example_zh: 請提早五分鐘加入電話會議。

example_en: You can dial in from your mobile phone.
example_zh: 你可以用手機撥號加入。

example_en: Enter the passcode to join the meeting.
example_zh: 輸入會議密碼即可加入會議。

example_en: The host will let you in shortly.
example_zh: 主持人很快會讓你進入會議。

example_en: Two guests are still in the waiting room.
example_zh: 還有兩位來賓在等候室。

example_en: Please mute yourself when you're not speaking.
example_zh: 不發言時請將自己靜音。

example_en: Ken, you're on mute. We can't hear you.
example_zh: Ken，你現在是靜音，我們聽不到。

example_en: Unmute yourself when you want to ask a question.
example_zh: 要提問時請取消靜音。

example_en: Let me share my screen to show the dashboard.
example_zh: 我分享螢幕給大家看儀表板。

zh: 大家看得到我的螢幕嗎？
example_en: I've started sharing. Can everyone see my screen?
example_zh: 我開始分享了，大家看得到我的螢幕嗎？

example_en: We'll split into breakout rooms for ten minutes.
example_zh: 我們分到分組討論室討論十分鐘。

example_en: Please raise your hand in the app to speak.
example_zh: 想發言請在 App 裡按舉手。

example_en: Sorry, you're breaking up. Could you repeat that?
example_zh: 抱歉，你的聲音斷斷續續，可以再說一次嗎？

example_en: Your video is frozen; try turning it off.
example_zh: 你的畫面卡住了，試著把視訊關掉。

example_en: We keep talking over each other; let's take turns.
example_zh: 我們一直同時搶話，大家輪流說吧。

example_en: Please mute to reduce background noise.
example_zh: 請靜音以減少背景噪音。

example_en: I think Lisa dropped off the call.
example_zh: 我想 Lisa 斷線了。

example_en: I'll leave and rejoin to fix my audio.
example_zh: 我先退出再重新加入，修一下聲音。

example_en: Could everyone please turn on your camera?
example_zh: 可以請大家都開啟鏡頭嗎？

zh: 混合式會議（實體加線上）
example_en: Hybrid meetings need a good microphone in the room.
example_zh: 混合式會議需要會議室裡有好的麥克風。

example_en: Just so you know, this meeting is being recorded.
example_zh: 提醒大家，本次會議正在錄影。

example_en: Please use the company virtual background.
example_zh: 請使用公司的虛擬背景。

example_en: Each presenter has fifteen minutes.
example_zh: 每位簡報者有十五分鐘。

example_en: Please send me the final slide deck.
example_zh: 請把最終版簡報檔寄給我。

example_en: On the next slide, you'll see our coverage area.
example_zh: 下一張投影片可以看到我們的訊號涵蓋範圍。

example_en: Here's the outline of today's presentation.
example_zh: 這是今天簡報的大綱。

en: The purpose of today's presentation is
example_en: The purpose of today's presentation is to propose a new plan.
example_zh: 今天簡報的目的是提出新方案。

example_en: I've divided my talk into three parts.
example_zh: 我的報告分成三個部分。

example_en: Now let's turn to the customer survey results.
example_zh: 現在我們接著來看客戶調查結果。

example_en: This brings me to my final point.
example_zh: 這就帶到我最後一個重點。

example_en: As you can see, data traffic doubled in March.
example_zh: 如各位所見，三月的數據流量翻倍了。

example_en: I'd like to draw your attention to this figure.
example_zh: 我想請各位注意這個數字。

example_en: Keep your key message short and simple.
example_zh: 核心訊息要簡短明瞭。

example_en: This bar chart compares data usage by region.
example_zh: 這張長條圖比較各區域的數據用量。

example_en: The pie chart shows our market share.
example_zh: 這張圓餅圖顯示我們的市占率。

example_en: The line graph shows monthly subscriber growth.
example_zh: 這張折線圖呈現每月用戶成長。

example_en: This flowchart explains the approval process.
example_zh: 這張流程圖說明核准流程。

example_en: The vertical axis shows revenue in millions.
example_zh: 縱軸表示營收，單位為百萬。
note: 複數為 axes

example_en: The legend explains what each color means.
example_zh: 圖例說明每個顏色代表的意思。

example_en: Network traffic peaks around 9 p.m.
example_zh: 網路流量在晚上九點左右達到高峰。

example_en: Growth leveled off in the second half.
example_zh: 下半年成長趨於平穩。

example_en: There was a slight dip in sales in July.
example_zh: 七月銷售略有下滑。

example_en: We saw a surge in sign-ups after the ad.
example_zh: 廣告播出後，申辦數激增。

example_en: Prices fluctuated throughout the quarter.
example_zh: 整季價格起伏不定。

example_en: Our 5G users have grown steadily.
example_zh: 我們的 5G 用戶穩定成長。

example_en: Equipment costs rose sharply last year.
example_zh: 去年設備成本急劇上升。

example_en: Taipei and Tainan grew 5% and 8% respectively.
example_zh: 台北和台南分別成長 5% 和 8%。

example_en: Use the laser pointer to highlight key figures.
example_zh: 用雷射筆標出關鍵數字。

example_en: The projector isn't connecting to my laptop.
example_zh: 投影機連不上我的筆電。

example_en: Can I borrow your clicker?
example_zh: 我可以借你的簡報筆嗎？

example_en: Good visual aids make data easier to follow.
example_zh: 好的視覺輔助工具讓數據更容易理解。

example_en: Let's rehearse the pitch before the client arrives.
example_zh: 客戶到之前我們先排練提案。

zh: 反問句（不需回答的提問）
example_en: Start with a rhetorical question to grab attention.
example_zh: 用一個反問句開場來抓住注意力。

zh: 電梯簡報（30 秒內的精簡介紹）
example_en: Prepare a 30-second elevator pitch for the product.
example_zh: 為這個產品準備一段 30 秒的電梯簡報。

example_en: We'll have a Q&A session at the end.
example_zh: 最後會有問答時間。

example_en: That's a good question. Let me explain.
example_zh: 這是個好問題，讓我說明一下。

en: I'll come back to that later.
example_en: I'll come back to that later in the presentation.
example_zh: 這點我在簡報後段再回答。

zh: 這樣有回答到您的問題嗎？
example_en: Does that answer your question, Mr. Yamada?
example_zh: 山田先生，這樣有回答到您的問題嗎？

example_en: Ask questions to engage the audience.
example_zh: 多提問來吸引聽眾參與。

example_en: In conclusion, the upgrade will pay for itself.
example_zh: 總而言之，這次升級的效益足以回本。

example_en: That's all from me. Thank you for your attention.
example_zh: 我的報告到此結束，感謝各位聆聽。

example_en: I keep my speaker notes on the laptop.
example_zh: 我把講者備忘稿放在筆電上。

example_en: Here are the talking points for the press event.
example_zh: 這是記者會的談話要點。

example_en: Let me walk you through the new process.
example_zh: 讓我逐步說明新流程。

example_en: The detailed figures are in the backup slides.
example_zh: 詳細數據在備用投影片裡。

example_en: Practice helps reduce stage fright.
example_zh: 多練習有助於減少怯場。

example_en: The manager will convene an urgent meeting this afternoon.
example_zh: 經理今天下午將召集緊急會議。

example_en: Let's reconvene after lunch at 1:30.
example_zh: 我們午餐後一點半再繼續開會。

zh: 請先保留日期（活動預告）
example_en: Save the date: our annual partner forum is on May 20.
example_zh: 請先保留日期：年度合作夥伴論壇在 5 月 20 日。

example_en: I'll send the meeting link ten minutes before we start.
example_zh: 我會在開始前十分鐘寄出會議連結。

example_en: I've sent you a meeting request for Thursday.
example_zh: 我已經寄給你週四的會議邀請。

example_en: Please check the seating arrangement for the client visit.
example_zh: 請確認客戶來訪時的座位安排。

example_en: Catering will deliver lunch boxes at noon.
example_zh: 外燴會在中午送來便當。

example_en: The dress code for the board meeting is business formal.
example_zh: 董事會會議的服裝規定是正式商務服裝。

example_en: Thanks for joining on such short notice.
example_zh: 感謝大家這麼臨時還能參加。

example_en: The review clashes with my client call.
example_zh: 這場檢討會和我的客戶電話會議撞期了。

example_en: I'm afraid I have a prior engagement that afternoon.
example_zh: 恐怕那天下午我已經有約了。

example_en: Our biweekly review is moved to Wednesday.
example_zh: 我們每兩週一次的檢討會改到週三。

example_en: We have a standing meeting every Monday at nine.
example_zh: 我們每週一早上九點有固定例會。

example_en: The CEO will answer questions at the town hall meeting.
example_zh: 執行長會在全員座談會上回答問題。

example_en: The budget will be approved at the board meeting.
example_zh: 預算將在董事會會議上核准。

example_en: We're holding a half-day workshop on 5G use cases.
example_zh: 我們將舉辦半天的 5G 應用案例工作坊。

example_en: The vendor invited us to a seminar on network security.
example_zh: 廠商邀請我們參加網路資安講座。

example_en: Over 300 customers registered for the webinar.
example_zh: 超過三百位客戶報名了這場線上研討會。

example_en: Our CEO will speak at the Asia telecom summit.
example_zh: 我們的執行長將在亞洲電信高峰會上演講。

example_en: The keynote speech focuses on AI in telecom.
example_zh: 這場專題演講聚焦在電信業的 AI 應用。

example_en: I'll attend the breakout session on network slicing.
example_zh: 我會參加網路切片的分組場次。

example_en: A delegation from head office arrives next week.
example_zh: 總公司的訪問團下週抵達。

example_en: Head office in Tokyo needs the report by Friday.
example_zh: 東京總公司要在週五前拿到報告。

example_en: Because of the time difference, let's meet at 8 a.m.
example_zh: 因為有時差，我們早上八點開會吧。

example_en: Thank you all for coming. Let's begin with the sales update.
example_zh: 謝謝大家出席。我們先從業務進度開始。

example_en: We're here today to finalize the launch plan.
example_zh: 我們今天開會是為了敲定上市計畫。

example_en: We're still waiting for Mr. Sato to join.
example_zh: 我們還在等佐藤先生加入。

example_en: Let's start with a quick round of introductions.
example_zh: 我們先快速輪流自我介紹。

example_en: Let's set some ground rules: phones on silent, please.
example_zh: 我們先訂幾條基本規則：請將手機調成靜音。

example_en: Let's timebox this discussion to fifteen minutes.
example_zh: 這個討論我們限定在十五分鐘內。

example_en: Quick time check: we have ten minutes left.
example_zh: 提醒一下時間：我們還剩十分鐘。

example_en: Let's hear from the sales team first.
example_zh: 我們先聽聽業務團隊的意見。

example_en: What are your thoughts on the new pricing?
example_zh: 你對新定價有什麼想法？

en: Would anyone like to add anything?
example_en: Before we move on, would anyone like to add anything?
example_zh: 在進入下一項之前，有人想補充嗎？

example_en: Can I just finish? I'm almost done.
example_zh: 我可以先講完嗎？我快說完了。

en: If I could just jump in
example_en: If I could just jump in, the cost is actually higher.
example_zh: 容我插個話，成本其實更高。

example_en: Getting back to the main issue, who will lead the trial?
example_zh: 回到主要議題，誰來負責這次試行？

example_en: Let's not get sidetracked by the logo design.
example_zh: 我們先別因為標誌設計而離題。

example_en: Sorry, I went off on a tangent there.
example_zh: 抱歉，我剛剛講得離題了。

example_en: Let's park this question and return to it later.
example_zh: 這個問題我們先擱置，稍後再回來討論。

example_en: In the interest of time, I'll skip the next two slides.
example_zh: 為了節省時間，我會跳過接下來兩張投影片。

example_en: Let's go around the table and share one update each.
example_zh: 我們輪流發言，每人分享一項進度。

example_en: Let's take a ten-minute break.
example_zh: 我們休息十分鐘。

example_en: Try not to let one person dominate the discussion.
example_zh: 盡量別讓一個人主導整場討論。

example_en: A good facilitator draws out the quieter members.
example_zh: 好的主持人會引導比較安靜的成員發言。

example_en: Please record the minority opinion in the minutes too.
example_zh: 請把少數意見也記錄在會議紀錄裡。

example_en: On a point of order, this item isn't on the agenda.
example_zh: 提出程序問題：這個項目不在議程上。
note: 正式會議中質疑議事程序時的用語

example_en: Thanks, Ken. Over to you, Lisa.
example_zh: 謝謝 Ken。接下來交給你，Lisa。

example_en: So we launch in March. Does everyone agree?
example_zh: 所以我們三月上市，大家都同意嗎？

example_en: I agree with you up to a point.
example_zh: 某種程度上我同意你。

example_en: I'm with you on that. The timeline is too tight.
example_zh: 這點我同意你，時程太趕了。

example_en: Fair enough. Let's use your numbers then.
example_zh: 說得也是，那就用你的數字吧。

example_en: You have a point there; we did underestimate the cost.
example_zh: 你說得有道理，我們確實低估了成本。

example_en: I beg to differ; customers want lower prices.
example_zh: 恕我不同意，客戶要的是更低的價格。

example_en: I'm still on the fence about the new vendor.
example_zh: 我對新廠商還在猶豫不決。

example_en: Legal has some reservations about the contract terms.
example_zh: 法務對合約條款有些保留意見。

example_en: We'll have to agree to disagree on this one.
example_zh: 這件事我們只好各自保留意見了。

example_en: Let's find some middle ground on the price.
example_zh: 我們在價格上找個折衷點吧。

example_en: We agree in principle, but need more details.
example_zh: 原則上我們同意，但需要更多細節。

example_en: I can go along with that proposal.
example_zh: 我可以贊成那個提案。

example_en: Another delay is out of the question.
example_zh: 再延誤一次是不可能的。

example_en: Is cheaper always better? Not necessarily.
example_zh: 便宜一定比較好嗎？不一定。

example_en: That makes sense. Let's go with option B.
example_zh: 有道理，我們就選方案 B。

example_en: I see it differently; the risk is quite low.
example_zh: 我的看法不同，風險其實相當低。

example_en: The motion is carried with eight votes in favor.
example_zh: 動議以八票贊成通過。

example_en: All those in favor, please raise your hands.
example_zh: 贊成的人請舉手。

example_en: The chair will be elected by secret ballot.
example_zh: 主席將以不記名投票選出。

example_en: The chairperson has the casting vote in a tie.
example_zh: 票數相同時由主席投下決定票。
note: 雙方票數相同時，由主席投出決定結果的一票

example_en: If you can't attend, you may vote by proxy.
example_zh: 若無法出席，可以委託代理人投票。

example_en: The proposal passed with two abstentions.
example_zh: 提案在兩票棄權下通過。

example_en: The committee endorsed the new travel policy.
example_zh: 委員會認可了新的差旅規定。

example_en: Do some nemawashi with each department before the meeting.
example_zh: 開會前先和各部門做好事前溝通。
note: 日式企業用語：正式會議前先私下取得相關人士同意

example_en: Please submit a ringi for the new server purchase.
example_zh: 請為新伺服器的採購提交稟議書。
note: 日式企業的書面簽核制度，文件逐層傳閱核章

example_en: Practice horenso: keep your boss informed at every step.
example_zh: 落實報連相：每個步驟都讓主管掌握狀況。
note: 日文「報告・連絡・相談」的縮寫，日商職場基本守則

example_en: Let's have a pre-meeting to align before the client call.
example_zh: 客戶會議前我們先開個會前會對齊一下。

example_en: Invite all key stakeholders to the review.
example_zh: 邀請所有主要利害關係人參加檢討會。

example_en: Each action item needs a clear action owner.
example_zh: 每個待辦事項都需要明確的負責人。

example_en: If we can't agree, let's put it to a vote.
example_zh: 如果無法達成共識，就付諸表決吧。

zh: 先給大家一些背景資訊，
example_en: To give you some background, this project started in 2024.
example_zh: 先給大家一些背景資訊，這個專案始於 2024 年。

example_en: Let me illustrate this with a real case.
example_zh: 讓我用一個實際案例來說明。

example_en: To put it another way, we lose one customer per hour.
example_zh: 換句話說，我們每小時流失一位客戶。

en: I'll be happy to take questions at the end.
zh: 最後我很樂意回答問題。
ipa: /aɪl bi ˈhæpi tə ˈteɪk ˈkwɛstʃənz ət ði ˈɛnd/
example_en: Please hold your questions; I'll be happy to take questions at the end.
example_zh: 請先保留問題，最後我很樂意回答。

en: That brings me to the end of my presentation.
ipa: /ðæt ˈbrɪŋz mi tə ði ˈɛnd əv maɪ ˌprɛzənˈteɪʃən/
example_en: That brings me to the end of my presentation. Thank you.
example_zh: 我的簡報到此結束，謝謝大家。

example_en: To summarize, sales grew but margins fell.
example_zh: 總結來說，營收成長但毛利下滑。

example_en: Moving on to our next point: customer feedback.
example_zh: 接下來談到下一點：客戶意見回饋。

example_en: The deck needs a clearer storyline.
example_zh: 這份簡報需要更清楚的主軸。

example_en: The president will give the opening remarks.
example_zh: 總經理會進行開場致詞。

example_en: Mr. Tanaka will make the closing remarks.
example_zh: 田中先生將發表結語。

example_en: Start with a surprising number as your hook.
example_zh: 用一個驚人的數字當開場切入點。

example_en: End your pitch with a clear call to action.
example_zh: 提案結尾要有明確的行動呼籲。

example_en: Know your audience before you prepare slides.
example_zh: 準備投影片之前先了解你的聽眾。

example_en: We have a rehearsal in the auditorium at three.
example_zh: 我們三點在禮堂彩排。

example_en: Let's do a dry run of the demo tomorrow.
example_zh: 我們明天先預演一次產品展示。

example_en: Write the key ideas on the flip chart.
example_zh: 把重點想法寫在白報紙架上。

example_en: Could you speak closer to the microphone?
example_zh: 可以靠近麥克風一點說話嗎？

example_en: Use presenter view to see your notes.
example_zh: 使用簡報者檢視畫面來看你的備忘稿。

example_en: Next slide, please. Here are the survey results.
example_zh: 請換下一張，這裡是調查結果。

example_en: Your transition between topics needs to be smoother.
example_zh: 你在主題之間的轉場要更流暢。

example_en: An infographic explains the process better than text.
example_zh: 資訊圖表比文字更能說明這個流程。

example_en: Put the executive summary on the first slide.
example_zh: 把摘要放在第一張投影片。

example_en: Can you prepare a one-pager for the VP?
example_zh: 你可以幫副總準備一頁式摘要嗎？

example_en: Keep eye contact with the audience, not the screen.
example_zh: 和聽眾保持眼神接觸，不要一直看螢幕。

example_en: Open body language makes you look confident.
example_zh: 開放的肢體語言讓你看起來更有自信。

example_en: Slow down your pace when you explain the numbers.
example_zh: 解說數字時要放慢語速。

example_en: Try to cut filler words like 'um' and 'you know'.
example_zh: 試著減少「嗯」「你知道」這類贅詞。

example_en: He answered the question off the cuff.
example_zh: 他即興回答了那個問題。

example_en: She opened with a short anecdote about a customer.
example_zh: 她用一個關於客戶的小故事開場。

example_en: Use an analogy to explain network slicing simply.
example_zh: 用比喻來簡單說明網路切片。

example_en: Customer data makes your argument more persuasive.
example_zh: 客戶數據讓你的論點更有說服力。

example_en: They presented a compelling business case.
example_zh: 他們提出了令人信服的商業論證。

example_en: Sales show a clear upward trend since April.
example_zh: 從四月起銷售呈現明顯上升趨勢。

example_en: Voice revenue continues its downward trend.
example_zh: 語音營收持續呈現下降趨勢。

example_en: We expect prices to bottom out next quarter.
example_zh: 我們預期價格會在下一季觸底。

example_en: Subscriber growth has plateaued this year.
example_zh: 今年用戶成長已趨於停滯。

example_en: Video traffic soared during the holidays.
example_zh: 假期期間影音流量大幅飆升。

example_en: Profits plummeted after the price war.
example_zh: 價格戰之後利潤暴跌。

example_en: Revenue rose 8% year-on-year.
example_zh: 營收較去年同期成長 8%。

example_en: Active users grew 3% quarter-on-quarter.
example_zh: 活躍用戶數較上一季成長 3%。

example_en: Our share fell by two percentage points.
example_zh: 我們的占比下滑了兩個百分點。

example_en: On average, each user consumes 20GB a month.
example_zh: 平均而言，每位用戶每月使用 20GB。

example_en: Here is a breakdown of costs by region.
example_zh: 這是各區域成本的分項明細。

example_en: We saw a significant drop in complaints.
example_zh: 我們看到客訴顯著減少。

example_en: The change made only a marginal difference.
example_zh: 這項改變只帶來些微差異。

example_en: Our forecast for next year is conservative.
example_zh: 我們對明年的預測相當保守。

example_en: We use last year's results as a benchmark.
example_zh: 我們以去年的成果作為基準。

example_en: Customer satisfaction is our top KPI this year.
example_zh: 客戶滿意度是我們今年最重要的關鍵績效指標。

example_en: As shown in the chart, sales peaked in May.
example_zh: 如圖表所示，銷售在五月達到高峰。

example_en: Let's remove the outlier from the analysis.
example_zh: 我們把這個異常值從分析中排除。

example_en: There's a strong correlation between speed and satisfaction.
example_zh: 速度和滿意度之間有很強的相關性。

example_en: We aim to grow our market share to 30%.
example_zh: 我們的目標是將市占率提升到 30%。

example_en: Enterprise clients account for half of our revenue.
example_zh: 企業客戶占我們營收的一半。

example_en: That's all from me. Does anyone have any questions?
example_zh: 我的部分就到這裡。有人有問題嗎？

zh: 很高興你問了這個問題。
example_en: I'm glad you asked that. It's a common concern.
example_zh: 很高興你問了這個，這是常見的疑慮。

en: off the top of my head
example_en: Off the top of my head, about 200 sites.
example_zh: 憑印象來說，大約兩百個站點。

zh: 可以請你再說一次問題嗎？
example_en: Sorry, could you repeat the question?
example_zh: 抱歉，可以請你再說一次問題嗎？

example_en: We'll launch in two phases. Does that make sense?
example_zh: 我們會分兩階段上市，這樣清楚嗎？

en: I don't have the figures at hand.
ipa: /aɪ ˈdoʊnt hæv ðə ˈfɪɡjərz ət ˈhænd/
example_en: I don't have the figures at hand, but I'll email them.
example_zh: 我手邊沒有數字，但我會用 email 寄給你。

example_en: That topic is out of scope for today.
example_zh: 那個主題超出今天討論的範圍。

en: I'll let my colleague answer that.
example_en: Good question. I'll let my colleague answer that.
example_zh: 好問題，這題我請同事來回答。

example_en: Can you hear me? Please give me a thumbs-up.
example_zh: 聽得到我的聲音嗎？聽得到請比個讚。

example_en: Turn on noise cancellation if you're calling from a café.
example_zh: 如果你在咖啡廳連線，請開啟降噪功能。

example_en: Sorry, I got disconnected. What did I miss?
example_zh: 抱歉，我剛斷線了。我錯過了什麼？

example_en: Please type your questions in the chat box.
example_zh: 請把問題打在聊天室窗裡。

example_en: I'll make you co-host so you can share slides.
example_zh: 我會把你設為共同主持人，讓你可以分享投影片。

example_en: Could you admit the guests from the waiting room?
example_zh: 可以讓等候室的來賓進來嗎？

example_en: Sorry, your audio keeps cutting out.
example_zh: 抱歉，你的聲音一直斷斷續續的。

example_en: Asynchronous updates save us a weekly meeting.
example_zh: 非同步更新讓我們省下一場週會。

example_en: Turn on live captions if the audio is unclear.
example_zh: 如果聲音聽不清楚，可以開啟即時字幕。

example_en: Simultaneous interpretation is available in Japanese.
example_zh: 現場提供日語同步口譯。

example_en: We'll need an interpreter for the Osaka meeting.
example_zh: 大阪的會議我們需要一位口譯員。

example_en: Let's run a quick poll to pick a date.
example_zh: 我們做個快速投票來選日期。

example_en: Who will take notes for this meeting?
example_zh: 這場會議由誰做筆記？

example_en: Add today's decisions to the decision log.
example_zh: 把今天的決議加到決議紀錄裡。

example_en: The installation is two weeks behind schedule.
example_zh: 安裝進度落後兩週。

example_en: We finished the testing ahead of schedule.
example_zh: 我們提前完成了測試。

example_en: Let's carry over the last item to next week.
example_zh: 最後一項我們延到下週再討論。

example_en: There are three open issues from last meeting.
example_zh: 上次會議還有三個未決事項。

example_en: Mr. Lin is absent today due to a business trip.
example_zh: 林先生今天因出差缺席。

zh: 缺席致歉（會議紀錄用語）
example_en: Apologies for absence were received from two members.
example_zh: 有兩位成員事先致歉缺席。
note: 英式正式會議紀錄開頭常見項目

example_en: You don't need to record the discussion verbatim.
example_zh: 討論內容不需要逐字記錄。

example_en: I'll distribute the materials before we start.
example_zh: 開始前我會先發資料。

example_en: Let me throw out an idea: what about a student plan?
example_zh: 我提一個想法：推出學生方案如何？

example_en: This session is for blue-sky thinking, so be bold.
example_zh: 這場是天馬行空的發想，請大膽提出。

zh: SWOT 分析（優勢、劣勢、機會、威脅）
example_en: Let's do a SWOT analysis of the new market.
example_zh: 我們來對新市場做 SWOT 分析。

example_en: We used a fishbone diagram to find the cause.
example_zh: 我們用魚骨圖找出原因。

example_en: Apply the five whys to understand the outage.
example_zh: 用五個為什麼的方法找出這次服務中斷的原因。
note: 連續追問「為什麼」約五次以找出根本原因

example_en: We'll use dot voting to pick the top three ideas.
example_zh: 我們用貼點投票選出前三名的想法。

example_en: Let's place each idea on an impact-effort matrix.
example_zh: 我們把每個想法放到效益／投入矩陣上。
note: 依「效益高低」與「投入多寡」排列想法的四象限圖

example_en: Let's check the feasibility before we commit.
example_zh: 承諾之前先確認可行性。

example_en: Let's start with the low-hanging fruit.
example_zh: 我們先從容易達成的目標著手。

example_en: We hold a retrospective at the end of each sprint.
example_zh: 每個衝刺週期結束時我們都會開回顧會議。

example_en: Let's document the lessons learned from this launch.
example_zh: 我們把這次上市的經驗教訓記錄下來。

example_en: Our long-term volume is a useful bargaining chip.
example_zh: 我們的長期採購量是很有用的談判籌碼。

example_en: We're willing to make a concession on delivery dates.
example_zh: 我們願意在交期上讓步。

example_en: The bottom line is we need to cut costs.
example_zh: 重點是我們必須削減成本。

example_en: Security requirements are non-negotiable.
example_zh: 資安要求沒有商量餘地。

example_en: She made a strong case for hiring two engineers.
example_zh: 她為增聘兩名工程師提出了有力的理由。

example_en: Can you justify the extra budget?
example_zh: 你能說明追加預算的理由嗎？

example_en: Please explain the rationale behind this decision.
example_zh: 請說明這項決定背後的理由。

example_en: As far as I'm concerned, the plan is ready.
example_zh: 就我而言，這個計畫已經準備好了。

example_en: If you ask me, we should wait until spring.
example_zh: 依我看，我們應該等到春天。

example_en: It seems to me that the real issue is staffing.
example_zh: 在我看來，真正的問題出在人力。

example_en: Why don't we ask the customer directly?
example_zh: 我們何不直接問客戶？

example_en: What if we split the rollout into two phases?
example_zh: 如果我們把建置分成兩階段呢？

example_en: Let's step back and look at the big picture.
example_zh: 我們退一步看看大局。

example_en: In a nutshell, the trial was a success.
example_zh: 簡而言之，這次試行很成功。

example_en: The cost is high. Having said that, the benefits are clear.
example_zh: 成本很高。話雖如此，效益很明顯。

example_en: Let's look at the problem from a different angle.
example_zh: 我們從不同角度來看這個問題。

example_en: It's six o'clock. Let's call it a day.
example_zh: 已經六點了，今天就到這裡吧。

example_en: Is there anything else we need to cover?
example_zh: 還有其他需要討論的事項嗎？

example_en: If there's nothing else, I'll close the meeting.
example_zh: 如果沒有其他事項，我就宣布散會。

example_en: Thanks, everyone. That was a productive meeting.
example_zh: 謝謝大家，這是場很有成效的會議。

example_en: In Japan, seating often follows seniority.
example_zh: 在日本，座位常依資歷安排。

example_en: The company has a top-down decision style.
example_zh: 這家公司採由上而下的決策方式。

example_en: We prefer a bottom-up approach for new ideas.
example_zh: 新點子我們偏好由下而上的方式。

example_en: Read the room before you push your proposal.
example_zh: 推動提案之前先看一下現場氣氛。

example_en: Raise concerns privately to help everyone save face.
example_zh: 私下提出疑慮，幫大家保全面子。

example_en: Managers should listen to their subordinates' ideas.
example_zh: 主管應該聆聽部屬的想法。

example_en: In Japan, exchange business cards with both hands.
example_zh: 在日本，交換名片要用雙手。

example_en: Guide the client to the seat of honor, farthest from the door.
example_zh: 請引導客戶坐在離門最遠的上座。
note: 日式商務禮儀：離門口最遠的位置留給客戶或最高位者

example_en: Please write a clear subject line.
example_zh: 請寫一個清楚的主旨。
note: 主旨要具體，例如含日期或專案名稱

example_en: Check the recipient before you hit send.
example_zh: 按下傳送前先確認收件人。

example_en: The sender's name looks unfamiliar.
example_zh: 這個寄件人的名字看起來很陌生。

example_en: The attachment is missing from your email.
example_zh: 你的信裡漏了附件。

example_en: My inbox is full after the holiday.
example_zh: 放完假後我的收件匣爆滿。

example_en: Please cc my manager on this email.
example_zh: 這封信請副本給我的主管。
note: carbon copy 的縮寫

example_en: I'll bcc all customers to protect their privacy.
example_zh: 我會用密件副本寄給所有客戶以保護隱私。
note: blind carbon copy，其他收件人看不到

example_en: Please don't reply all to this message.
example_zh: 這封信請不要按全部回覆。

example_en: Could you forward me the customer's email?
example_zh: 可以把客戶那封信轉寄給我嗎？

example_en: See the email thread below for background.
example_zh: 背景請見下方的郵件串。

example_en: Please add your phone number to your email signature.
example_zh: 請在郵件簽名檔加上你的電話。

example_en: I saved the reply as a draft.
example_zh: 我把回信存成草稿了。

example_en: Your email went to my spam folder.
example_zh: 你的信跑到我的垃圾郵件匣了。

example_en: Please add me to the project distribution list.
example_zh: 請把我加進專案的群組收件名單。

example_en: I requested a read receipt for the contract email.
example_zh: 合約那封信我有要求讀取回條。

example_en: My email to the supplier bounced back.
example_zh: 我寄給供應商的信被退回了。

example_en: I got his out-of-office reply until Monday.
example_zh: 我收到他到週一前不在辦公室的自動回覆。
note: 常縮寫為 OOO

example_en: Please set an auto-reply before your trip.
example_zh: 出差前請設定自動回覆。

example_en: I'm composing a reply to the client now.
example_zh: 我正在撰寫給客戶的回信。

example_en: Use a formal salutation for new clients.
example_zh: 給新客戶的信請用正式稱呼開頭。
note: 例如 Dear Ms. Lin,

example_en: "Best regards" is a safe sign-off.
example_zh: 「Best regards」是很保險的結語。

example_en: She added a postscript about the office party.
example_zh: 她在信末附註了尾牙的事。

example_en: Send all orders to the sales shared mailbox.
example_zh: 所有訂單請寄到業務部的共用信箱。

example_en: I'll send you a calendar invite for Thursday.
example_zh: 我會寄週四的行事曆邀請給你。

example_en: Please don't mark routine emails as urgent.
example_zh: 一般例行信件請不要標示為緊急。

example_en: I flagged your email so I won't forget.
example_zh: 我把你的信加了標記，免得忘記。

example_en: I archive old emails every Friday.
example_zh: 我每週五封存舊郵件。

example_en: Click here to unsubscribe from this newsletter.
example_zh: 點這裡取消訂閱這份電子報。

example_en: Report any phishing email to IT immediately.
example_zh: 收到釣魚郵件請立刻通報資訊部。

example_en: Could you confirm your email address?
example_zh: 可以確認一下你的電子郵件地址嗎？

zh: 親愛的某某先生／女士（正式開頭）
example_en: Dear Mr. / Ms. Chen, thank you for your email.
example_zh: 陳先生／女士您好，感謝您的來信。
note: Ms. 不透露婚姻狀態，比 Miss/Mrs. 安全

example_en: To whom it may concern, I am writing about an invoice.
example_zh: 敬啟者：本信是關於一張發票。
note: 不知道收件人姓名時使用，偏正式

en: I hope this email finds you well
ipa: /aɪ hoʊp ðɪs ˈiːmeɪl faɪndz juː wel/
example_en: I hope this email finds you well.
example_zh: 希望您一切安好。
note: 常見的客套開場白

example_en: I am writing to confirm our order.
example_zh: 來信是為了確認我們的訂單。

en: I am writing on behalf of
example_en: I am writing on behalf of our CEO.
example_zh: 謹代表本公司執行長來信。

example_en: Thank you for your email about the delivery.
example_zh: 感謝您來信詢問交貨事宜。

en: Thank you for getting back to me
ipa: /θæŋk juː fɔːr ˈɡetɪŋ bæk tə miː/
example_en: Thank you for getting back to me so quickly.
example_zh: 謝謝您這麼快回覆我。

example_en: Further to our call, here is the quote.
example_zh: 延續我們的通話，附上報價。
note: 英式正式用法

example_en: As per our discussion, I've updated the schedule.
example_zh: 依照我們討論的內容，我已更新時程。

example_en: With reference to your order, delivery is confirmed.
example_zh: 關於您的訂單，交貨已確認。

example_en: I'm reaching out to ask about your new plan.
example_zh: 我來信是想詢問你們的新方案。
note: 比 I am writing to 口語親切

example_en: Allow me to introduce myself as your new account manager.
example_zh: 請容我自我介紹，我是您的新客戶經理。

en: It was a pleasure meeting you
example_en: It was a pleasure meeting you in Tokyo.
example_zh: 很高興在東京與您見面。

example_en: Sorry for the late reply; I was traveling.
example_zh: 抱歉晚回覆，我剛才在出差。

example_en: Apologies for the delayed response to your inquiry.
example_zh: 抱歉延遲回覆您的詢問。
note: 比 Sorry for the late reply 更正式

example_en: Just a quick note to say the files are ready.
example_zh: 簡單跟你說一聲，檔案準備好了。

example_en: Hi team, please see the update below.
example_zh: 大家好，請看以下更新。

en: Thank you for your continued support
zh: 感謝您一直以來的支持（承蒙關照）
example_en: Thank you for your continued support.
example_zh: 感謝您一直以來的支持。
note: 接近日文「いつもお世話になっております」

en: I look forward to our continued cooperation
ipa: /aɪ lʊk ˈfɔːrwɚd tuː ˈaʊɚ kənˈtɪnjuːd koʊˌɑːpəˈreɪʃən/
example_en: I look forward to our continued cooperation.
example_zh: 期待今後持續合作。
note: 接近日文「今後ともよろしくお願いいたします」

example_en: Sorry to bother you, but I have one more question.
example_zh: 不好意思打擾，我還有一個問題。

example_en: Please find attached the revised quotation.
example_zh: 附件為修改後的報價單，請查收。

example_en: I have attached the meeting minutes.
example_zh: 我已附上會議紀錄。

example_en: The enclosed form must be signed.
example_zh: 隨信附上的表格需要簽名。
note: 原指紙本信件同封，email 也常用

example_en: I've attached last year's report for your reference.
example_zh: 附上去年的報告供您參考。
note: 縮寫 FYR

example_en: The draft contract is attached for your review.
example_zh: 附上合約草稿，請您審閱。

example_en: Here is a copy of the receipt for your records.
example_zh: 這是收據副本，供您存檔。

example_en: Please see below for the customer's request.
example_zh: 客戶的需求請見下方。

example_en: Please see the link below to download the slides.
example_zh: 請由下方連結下載簡報。

example_en: Could you resend the file? I can't open it.
example_zh: 可以重寄那個檔案嗎？我打不開。

example_en: The video exceeds the file size limit.
example_zh: 這個影片超過檔案大小上限。

example_en: The file is password-protected; I'll send the password separately.
example_zh: 檔案有密碼保護，密碼我另外寄。
note: 日商常見做法：附件加密、密碼另寄

example_en: I've uploaded the photos to the shared folder.
example_zh: 照片我已經上傳到共用資料夾。

example_en: Could you grant me access permission to the folder?
example_zh: 可以給我那個資料夾的存取權限嗎？

example_en: Could you please check the figures again?
example_zh: 可以麻煩您再核對一次數字嗎？

example_en: Would you mind sending it again?
example_zh: 您介意再寄一次嗎？
note: 後面接動名詞 -ing

example_en: I would appreciate it if you could reply by Friday.
example_zh: 若您能在週五前回覆，將不勝感激。

example_en: I'd be grateful if you could share the data.
example_zh: 如果您能提供資料，我會很感激。

example_en: Please let me know if Monday works.
example_zh: 週一可不可以請告訴我。

example_en: Please reply at your earliest convenience.
example_zh: 請您方便時儘早回覆。
note: 客氣但仍有催促意味

example_en: Which option do you prefer? Please advise.
example_zh: 您偏好哪個方案？請告知。

example_en: Kindly confirm receipt of this email.
example_zh: 敬請確認收到此信。
note: 語氣正式，用太多會顯得生硬

example_en: Please feel free to call me anytime.
example_zh: 請隨時打電話給我。

example_en: I was wondering if you could join the call.
example_zh: 不知道您能否參加這通會議。
note: 委婉提出請求

example_en: Would it be possible to extend the deadline?
example_zh: 截止日是否有可能延後？

example_en: Please fill out the attached form.
example_zh: 請填寫附件的表格。

example_en: Please sign and return the NDA by Friday.
example_zh: 請在週五前把保密協議簽名後寄回。

example_en: Please acknowledge receipt of this notice.
example_zh: 請確認收到本通知。

example_en: Could you share the latest traffic report?
example_zh: 可以提供最新的流量報告嗎？

example_en: Please review and approve the budget by Wednesday.
example_zh: 請在週三前審核並核准預算。

example_en: We kindly ask that you pay within 30 days.
example_zh: 懇請您於三十天內付款。

example_en: I'm following up on my email from last week.
example_zh: 我想跟進上週寄的那封信。

example_en: I'll send a follow-up after the meeting.
example_zh: 會後我會寄一封後續信件。

example_en: Just a gentle reminder about tomorrow's deadline.
example_zh: 溫馨提醒一下明天的截止日。
note: 催人時的客氣說法

example_en: Just checking in on the status of the order.
example_zh: 想確認一下訂單的進度。

example_en: Any update on the repair schedule?
example_zh: 維修時程有任何進展嗎？

example_en: I haven't heard back from the vendor yet.
example_zh: 我還沒收到廠商的回音。

example_en: Let's circle back on pricing next week.
example_zh: 價格的部分我們下週再回頭討論。

example_en: Could you chase the supplier for the invoice?
example_zh: 可以幫忙向供應商催一下發票嗎？
note: 英式用法常見

example_en: There are still two outstanding issues.
example_zh: 還有兩個問題尚未處理。
note: 另有「傑出的」意思，看上下文

example_en: We are awaiting your reply on the proposal.
example_zh: 我們正在等候您對提案的回覆。

example_en: Let's touch base on Friday afternoon.
example_zh: 我們週五下午簡單聯繫一下。

example_en: Please keep me posted on the test results.
example_zh: 測試結果有消息請隨時通知我。

example_en: Please keep me in the loop on this issue.
example_zh: 這件事請讓我掌握最新狀況。

example_en: I'm looping in Ken from the legal team.
example_zh: 我把法務部的 Ken 加進來。

example_en: As a reminder, the office is closed on Monday.
example_zh: 提醒一下，週一辦公室休息。

example_en: This is a second reminder about the unpaid invoice.
example_zh: 這是關於未付發票的第二次提醒。

example_en: Are you available for a call tomorrow?
example_zh: 您明天有空通個電話嗎？

example_en: Does 3 p.m. Tuesday work for you?
example_zh: 週二下午三點您方便嗎？

example_en: Thursday morning? That works for me.
example_zh: 週四上午嗎？我可以。

example_en: Could you propose a time that suits you?
example_zh: 可以提議一個您方便的時間嗎？

example_en: Can we reschedule the call to next week?
example_zh: 這通會議可以改到下週嗎？

example_en: Please pick a time slot from the list.
example_zh: 請從清單中選一個時段。

example_en: The meeting is at 10 a.m. Tokyo time zone.
example_zh: 會議是東京時區上午十點。
note: 台灣 UTC+8，日本 UTC+9

example_en: The date is tentative until the client confirms.
example_zh: 客戶確認前，這個日期是暫定的。

example_en: I have a scheduling conflict on Monday.
example_zh: 我週一有行程衝突。

example_en: Sorry, I'm double-booked at that time.
example_zh: 抱歉，我那個時段已經撞期了。

example_en: Can we push back the meeting by an hour?
example_zh: 會議可以往後延一小時嗎？
note: 另有「反對」之意

example_en: We need to bring forward the launch date.
example_zh: 我們需要把上市日期提前。

example_en: Noted, thank you for the update.
example_zh: 了解，謝謝更新。
note: 簡短回覆，對長官可加 with thanks

example_en: Your documents are well received.
example_zh: 您的文件已收到。
note: 亞洲商務常見，母語者多說 I've received

example_en: Understood. I'll fix it today.
example_zh: 明白了，我今天會修正。

example_en: Just to confirm, the deadline is the 15th?
example_zh: 再確認一下，截止日是 15 號嗎？

zh: 說明清楚一點；澄清一下
example_en: To clarify, the price excludes tax.
example_zh: 澄清一下，這個價格不含稅。

example_en: I need some clarification on item 3.
example_zh: 第三項我需要進一步說明。

example_en: Could you elaborate on the second point?
example_zh: 第二點可以詳細說明嗎？

zh: 如果我理解有誤請指正
example_en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but the order is 500 units?
example_zh: 如果我理解有誤請指正，訂單是 500 個嗎？

example_en: As mentioned, the system will be down tonight.
example_zh: 如先前所述，系統今晚會停機。

example_en: As discussed, I've sent the draft to legal.
example_zh: 如同我們討論的，草稿已寄給法務。

example_en: I want to make sure we're on the same page.
example_zh: 我想確認我們的認知一致。

example_en: Sorry, there seems to be a misunderstanding.
example_zh: 抱歉，這裡好像有點誤會。

example_en: I apologize for the error in the invoice.
example_zh: 發票有誤，深感抱歉。

example_en: We regret to inform you that the item is out of stock.
example_zh: 很遺憾通知您，該商品已缺貨。

example_en: We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
example_zh: 造成不便，敬請見諒。

example_en: Sorry for any confusion; here is the correct file.
example_zh: 抱歉造成混淆，這是正確的檔案。

example_en: Due to an oversight, the file was not attached.
example_zh: 因為疏忽，檔案沒有附上。

example_en: The previous email was sent in error.
example_zh: 前一封信是誤寄的。

example_en: Please disregard my previous message.
example_zh: 請忽略我前一封訊息。

example_en: Sorry, there was a typo in the date.
example_zh: 抱歉，日期打錯了。

example_en: Apologies for the short notice, but can we meet today?
example_zh: 抱歉臨時通知，我們今天可以碰面嗎？

example_en: Thanks for reporting the outage. We are looking into it.
example_zh: 感謝通報斷線，我們正在調查處理。

example_en: We will rectify the billing error immediately.
example_zh: 我們會立刻更正帳單錯誤。

example_en: Thank you in advance for your help.
example_zh: 先謝謝您的協助。

example_en: Your quick reply is much appreciated.
example_zh: 非常感謝您迅速回覆。

example_en: Thank you for your patience while we fix the issue.
example_zh: 感謝您在我們處理問題期間耐心等候。

example_en: Thank you for your understanding during the maintenance.
example_zh: 維護期間感謝您的體諒。

example_en: Thank you for your cooperation with the survey.
example_zh: 感謝您配合填寫問卷。

example_en: Thank you for your time on the call today.
example_zh: 感謝您今天撥冗通話。

example_en: Thanks for the heads-up about the price change.
example_zh: 謝謝你事先告知價格調整。

example_en: Thanks for flagging this. I'll check with the team.
example_zh: 謝謝你提出來，我會跟團隊確認。

example_en: I truly appreciate your support on this project.
example_zh: 由衷感謝您對這個專案的支持。

example_en: Best regards, Amy Chen
example_zh: 敬祝順心，陳艾美
note: 最通用的商務結語

example_en: Kind regards, Kevin
example_zh: 謹致問候，Kevin

example_en: Sincerely, Lisa Wang, Sales Manager
example_zh: 業務經理 王麗莎 敬上
note: 較正式，常用於信函

zh: 溫馨問候（較親切的結語）
example_en: Warm regards, and see you next week.
example_zh: 溫馨問候，下週見。

example_en: Yours faithfully, Customer Service Team
example_zh: 客服團隊 謹啟
note: 英式；開頭用 Dear Sir/Madam 時搭配

en: Looking forward to hearing from you
example_en: Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
example_zh: 期待很快收到您的回音。

en: Looking forward to working with you
example_en: Looking forward to working with you on this project.
example_zh: 期待在這個專案與您合作。

en: Please do not hesitate to contact me
zh: 如有需要請隨時與我聯絡
ipa: /pliːz duː nɑːt ˈhezɪteɪt tə ˈkɑːntækt miː/
example_en: If you have questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
example_zh: 如有任何問題，請隨時與我聯絡。

en: Let me know if you need anything else
ipa: /let miː noʊ ɪf juː niːd ˈeniθɪŋ els/
example_en: Let me know if you need anything else from me.
example_zh: 還需要我提供什麼請跟我說。

example_en: Thanks again, and have a great weekend!
example_zh: 再次感謝，祝週末愉快！

example_en: Thanks, Mike. Talk to you soon.
example_zh: 謝了 Mike，再聊。
note: 較口語，用於熟識同事

example_en: This is urgent. The customer is waiting.
example_zh: 這件事很緊急，客戶在等。

example_en: This request is time-sensitive, so please reply today.
example_zh: 這個需求有時效性，請今天回覆。

example_en: Fixing the outage is our top priority.
example_zh: 修復斷線是我們的最優先事項。

example_en: Please submit it no later than May 10.
example_zh: 請最遲在 5 月 10 日前提交。

example_en: I need it by Thursday at the latest.
example_zh: 我最晚週四要拿到。

example_en: Could you expedite the shipment?
example_zh: 可以加快出貨嗎？

example_en: Please send the report as soon as possible.
example_zh: 請儘快寄出報告。
note: ASAP 對客戶或長官用可能顯得命令

example_en: FYI, the client has changed the meeting room.
example_zh: 供參考，客戶換了會議室。

example_en: Please send your comments by EOD.
example_zh: 請在今天下班前給意見。

example_en: Payment must be received by COB Friday.
example_zh: 款項必須在週五營業結束前入帳。
note: 跨時區時最好註明是哪個時區

example_en: What's the ETA for the new router?
example_zh: 新路由器預計什麼時候到？
note: estimated time of arrival

example_en: The venue is still TBD.
example_zh: 場地還待定。

example_en: Start time: 9 a.m. (TBC)
example_zh: 開始時間：上午九點（待確認）

example_en: If a field doesn't apply, write N/A.
example_zh: 不適用的欄位請填 N/A。

example_en: RE: Quotation for fiber installation
example_zh: 回覆：光纖安裝報價

example_en: FW: Customer complaint from Osaka branch
example_zh: 轉寄：大阪分公司的客訴
note: 也寫作 FWD:

example_en: I'll be OOO from July 1 to 5.
example_zh: 我 7 月 1 日到 5 日不在辦公室。

example_en: BTW, the slides are in the shared folder.
example_zh: 順帶一提，簡報放在共用資料夾。
note: 只用於熟識同事

example_en: List the costs, e.g., travel and hotel.
example_zh: 列出費用，例如交通和住宿。
note: 拉丁文 exempli gratia

example_en: Send it by month-end, i.e., October 31.
example_zh: 請月底前寄出，也就是 10 月 31 日。
note: 和 e.g. 不同：i.e. 是換句話說

zh: 自某日起的那一週（week commencing）
example_en: Let's plan the training for w/c June 9.
example_zh: 訓練就排在 6 月 9 日那一週吧。

example_en: We agree. However, the budget is limited.
example_zh: 我們同意，不過預算有限。

example_en: The part is delayed; therefore, shipping will be late.
example_zh: 零件延遲，因此出貨會晚。

example_en: In addition, we offer free installation.
example_zh: 此外，我們提供免費安裝。

example_en: Furthermore, the new plan includes 5G.
example_zh: 而且，新方案包含 5G。

example_en: Prices have risen, and we have updated the quote accordingly.
example_zh: 價格上漲，我們已相應更新報價。

example_en: In the meantime, please use the backup line.
example_zh: 在此期間，請使用備援線路。

example_en: Alternatively, we can meet online.
example_zh: 或者，我們也可以線上開會。

example_en: In light of the typhoon, the visit is canceled.
example_zh: 鑑於颱風，此次拜訪取消。

example_en: With regard to your question, the answer is yes.
example_zh: 關於您的問題，答案是可以。

example_en: In response to your request, here are the logs.
example_zh: 回應您的需求，附上紀錄檔。

example_en: The aforementioned changes take effect next month.
example_zh: 前述變更將於下個月生效。
note: 非常正式，日常信件少用

example_en: Please be advised that our office will move in May.
example_zh: 特此通知，本公司辦公室將於五月搬遷。

example_en: Please note that prices exclude tax.
example_zh: 請注意，價格不含稅。

example_en: We are pleased to announce our new fiber service.
example_zh: 我們很高興宣布推出新的光纖服務。

example_en: Effective immediately, all orders need approval.
example_zh: 即日起，所有訂單都需要核准。

example_en: The service is suspended until further notice.
example_zh: 此服務暫停，直到另行通知。

example_en: Going forward, please cc me on all orders.
example_zh: 今後所有訂單請副本給我。

example_en: I'll circulate the minutes after the meeting.
example_zh: 會後我會把紀錄發給大家。

example_en: Our monthly newsletter goes out on the 1st.
example_zh: 我們的月刊電子報每月 1 號寄出。

example_en: HR sent an announcement about the new holiday.
example_zh: 人資寄了一封新假日的公告。

example_en: I'd like to introduce Mr. Sato, our new engineer.
example_zh: 我想介紹我們的新工程師佐藤先生。

example_en: I'm copying in my colleague, who handles billing.
example_zh: 我把負責帳務的同事加進副本。

example_en: Jenny will be your point of contact.
example_zh: Jenny 會是您的聯絡窗口。

example_en: Who is in charge of this account?
example_zh: 這個客戶是誰負責的？

example_en: I'll ask my counterpart in Japan.
example_zh: 我會問日本那邊的對口窗口。

example_en: Thanks, Tom. Moving you to bcc to spare your inbox.
example_zh: 謝謝 Tom，把你移到密件副本，省得你收一堆信。
note: 引介完雙方後的禮貌說法

example_en: The director needs to sign off on the plan.
example_zh: 這份計畫需要處長正式批准。

example_en: I'd welcome your input on the draft.
example_zh: 歡迎您對草稿提供意見。

example_en: I'll revise the proposal based on your comments.
example_zh: 我會依您的意見修改提案。

example_en: We hope to finalize the details this week.
example_zh: 我們希望本週把細節定案。

example_en: We're waiting for the client's go-ahead.
example_zh: 我們在等客戶點頭。

example_en: I'm afraid we must decline your offer.
example_zh: 恐怕我們必須婉拒您的提議。

example_en: I'm afraid I can't make it on Monday.
example_zh: 恐怕我週一沒辦法參加。

example_en: Please edit the contract with track changes on.
example_zh: 請開啟追蹤修訂來修改合約。

example_en: I'll have limited access to email next week.
example_zh: 我下週無法經常收信。

example_en: In my absence, please contact Mr. Lee.
example_zh: 我不在期間，請聯絡李先生。

example_en: I'll be back in the office on Tuesday.
example_zh: 我週二會回到辦公室。

example_en: I'm on annual leave until August 20.
example_zh: 我特休到 8 月 20 日。

example_en: Our Taiwan office is closed for a public holiday.
example_zh: 台灣辦公室因國定假日休息。

example_en: I'll respond to the customer by noon.
example_zh: 我中午前會答覆客戶。

example_en: Thank you for your inquiry about our plans.
example_zh: 感謝您洽詢我們的方案。

example_en: I sent a courtesy copy to your manager.
example_zh: 我寄了一份知會副本給你的主管。
note: 現代 cc 也常被解釋為 courtesy copy

example_en: Keep your emails short and concise.
example_zh: 信件請寫得簡短扼要。

example_en: I've listed the key issues in bullet points.
example_zh: 我把重點問題用條列方式寫出來。

example_en: Your action items are highlighted in yellow.
example_zh: 你的待辦事項用黃色標出來了。

example_en: I've highlighted the changes in red.
example_zh: 我已用紅色標示修改處。

zh: 直接寫在原文中的回覆
example_en: Please see my inline comments in blue below.
example_zh: 請看下方我用藍字直接回在原文中的意見。

example_en: This email is confidential. Please don't forward it.
example_zh: 這封信是機密，請勿轉寄。

example_en: Our email disclaimer is added automatically.
example_zh: 我們的郵件免責聲明是自動加上的。

example_en: If you are not the intended recipient, please delete this email.
example_zh: 若您非指定收件人，請刪除此信。
note: 常見於郵件免責聲明

example_en: Please reply by Wednesday noon.
example_zh: 請於週三中午前回覆。

en: Hope you had a great weekend
example_en: Hi Ken, hope you had a great weekend.
example_zh: Ken 你好，希望你週末過得愉快。

example_en: Thanks and regards, Peter Huang
example_zh: 謝謝，敬祝順心。黃彼得

example_en: Which email client do you use, Outlook or Gmail?
example_zh: 你用哪個郵件軟體，Outlook 還是 Gmail？

example_en: You can check your mail through webmail when traveling.
example_zh: 出差時可以用網頁版信箱收信。

example_en: My mailbox quota is almost full.
example_zh: 我的信箱容量快滿了。
note: 信箱滿了，別人寄來的信會被退回

example_en: Your reply went to my junk mail folder.
example_zh: 你的回信跑到我的垃圾郵件匣了。
note: 意思同 spam

example_en: I received a delivery failure notice, so please check your address.
example_zh: 我收到寄送失敗的通知，請確認你的信箱地址。

example_en: I got an 'undeliverable' notice for this address.
example_zh: 寄到這個地址收到「無法送達」的通知。

example_en: I tried to recall the message, but he had already read it.
example_zh: 我試著收回那封信，但他已經讀了。
